findings.claim: UDP `recv` readiness handling changed to include error readiness, which may alter how socket errors are surfaced on the read path.
supporting_facts: Semantic evidence reports `readiness_error_propagation_changed` for `.async_io(Interest::READABLE | Interest::ERROR, || self.io.recv(buf))` in `tokio/src/net/udp.rs` with high confidence.
Quality evidence notes production code changed with accompanying test changes.
findings.limitation: The signal is based on an explicit scanned pattern, not full semantic verification of all UDP readiness behavior.
findings.review_action: Review error-path readiness registration for `recv` and require regression coverage for surfaced socket errors.
